name: Ethos Furniture Colorado Springs
old_description: Standing tall and proud the mighty Giant Sequoia tree was the inspiration for this modern organic table design. Walking through a Giant Sequoia grove, one is struck by the awe-inspiring size and symmetry of these most mighty of timbers. Inspired by these majestic monoliths, we have paired down their columnar look into this sleek design, perfect for any space. Add a bit of organic flair to your dining space or kitchen with the Sequoia dining table.
about:
Ethos Furniture operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, where it produces custom-built furniture and tables. The company sells directly through its website, offering pieces such as the Sequoia Dining Table, inspired by the columnar form of giant sequoias, and the Easton Sideboard, a client favorite. No founding year, ownership details, or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The shop focuses on made-to-measure designs crafted from sustainable American hardwoods. Finishes are formulated with 0% VOC ecoconscience coatings, supplemented by premium protectants and pigments. All items are manufactured in the United States, and the company highlights domestic production as a core attribute. Specific wood species, facility size, headcount, annual volume, or part-number counts are not published.

Customers can schedule virtual or in-person design guidance to customize dimensions, materials, and finishes. The business serves individual buyers seeking bespoke residential furniture; no industrial or commercial client segments are explicitly listed. Minimum order quantities, lead times, and tolerance specifications are not provided.

Ethos Furniture emphasizes its domestic production, low-emission finishes, and made-to-measure approach as key differentiators, positioning itself as a source for bespoke, environmentally conscious furniture.
